answer: A lotus-style reputation bloom powers the most convincing sybil defense: peer-prediction scoring, where graders stake tokens at dawn of each review round and are paid by how well their scores predict the calibrated panel average, under strictly proper scoring rules. Honest, careful grading is the only profitable strategy. Fake-identity inlets fail: each sybil must grade accurately to earn, losing stake instead of gaining influence. The attacker pays locked capital plus real expert effort per fake account, so sybils cost more than they extract.
